rdf:Description.oops:hasMessage: If you have entered a URI make sure that it is available on-line using, for example, Vapour or Hyperthing.
Also make sure that your ontology RDF or OWL code is correct using an RDF validator as http://www.w3.org/RDF/Validator/ or an OWL validator as http://www.mygrid.org.uk/OWL/Validator.

If the URI and the ontology are correct but OOPS! is not able to analyze it, please, let us know by email (oops(at)delicias.dia.fi.upm.es) attaching the file or indicating the ontology URI and we will find out what was wrong within OOPS!.
